description: This file provides support functions for live cache testing, including heartbeat management, timeout handling, model resolution, and message building, specifically for the openclaw project.

classes.name: LiveResolvedModel
classes.description: Type representing a resolved model with associated API key and model details.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer with a fallback default.

methods.name: logLiveCache
methods.description: Logs messages to standard error with a specific prefix.

methods.name: withLiveCacheHeartbeat
methods.description: Runs an async operation with periodic heartbeat logs.

methods.name: completeSimpleWithLiveTimeout
methods.description: Executes a model completion with a timeout and heartbeat monitoring.

methods.name: buildStableCachePrefix
methods.description: Generates a deterministic cache prefix string for stability across retries.

methods.name: extractAssistantText
methods.description: Extracts concatenated text content from an AssistantMessage.

methods.name: buildAssistantHistoryTurn
methods.description: Creates an AssistantMessage for a history turn with zero usage.

methods.name: computeCacheHitRate
methods.description: Calculates the cache hit rate based on usage statistics.

methods.name: resolveLiveDirectModel
methods.description: Resolves and retrieves a live model and API key based on environment and preferences.
